decisions.reason: Because this biodynamic yogurt stayed on the website after launch, fits the firm's established organic dairy competencies and range, and faces a growing market, management would likely see results as at least near aspiration and keep it.

As a 2024 launch very close to the core cheese business, mild sliced cheese is likely to be given more time under normal organisational slack unless early results clearly fall short of aspiration, so it would be kept.

Sliced butter cheese also matches the firm's existing capabilities and broad portfolio, and although it is still early and somewhat uncertain, management would more likely continue than redeploy resources immediately.
